info.name: OneAI-Cortex API v0.4.0
info.description:
Open-source AI agent builder platform. Build, test, evaluate, and deploy agents.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except health) require one of:
- `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` — JWT from OneAI-Auth
- `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` — Cortex-issued API key

Set the `jwt_token` or `api_key` collection variable, then select the appropriate auth type per request.

## SSE Streaming

Chat and resume endpoints return Server-Sent Events. Set `Accept: text/event-stream` header (already configured in collection).

## Tool Catalog & Playground (v0.2.0)

61 pre-built LangChain tools across 20 categories are seeded at startup. Browse by category, filter tools, and test any tool in the playground with your own API keys before attaching it to an agent.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness and readiness probes. No authentication required.

request.description: Returns 200 if the process is running. Use for container liveness probes.
Checks database, Redis, and OneAI-Auth connectivity. Use for readiness probes.

item.name: API Keys
item.description: Manage Cortex-local API keys for programmatic agent access.

exec: console.log('API Key saved (shown once only): ' + json.key);

request.description: Creates a new API key. The raw key is returned ONCE in the response — save it immediately. Auto-saves `key_id` and `api_key` variables.
Lists all API keys for the authenticated user. Raw keys are never shown — only prefixes.
Revokes (soft-deletes) an API key. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Agents
item.description: Agent CRUD with immutable versioning. Every config change creates a new version.

request.description: Creates a new agent with version 1. Config secrets (user_api_keys) are encrypted at rest. Auto-saves `agent_id` variable.
Paginated list of agents owned by the authenticated user.
Get a single agent by ID.
Updates an agent. If config changes, a new immutable version is created automatically.
Soft-deletes an agent. Returns 204 No Content.
List all versions of an agent, paginated.
Get a specific version of an agent by version number.

item.name: Runner
item.description: Execute agents via SSE streaming with session persistence and HITL support.

request.description: Creates a new chat session for an agent. Auto-saves `session_id` variable.

Resume execution after a Human-in-the-Loop interrupt.

- `approved: true` — continue with the proposed action
- `approved: false` — reject the action
- `modified_args` — optionally modify the tool call arguments before continuing

item.name: Evaluator
item.description: Test suites, test cases, and evaluation runs for automated agent testing.

request.description:
Create a test suite for an agent.

Scoring methods: `exact_match`, `contains`, `llm_judge`
Add a test case to a suite. `expected_output` is compared against the agent's response using the suite's scoring method.
Runs all test cases in the suite against the agent's current version. Returns aggregated metrics (avg score, pass rate, mean latency).
Get per-test-case results for an evaluation run. Includes actual output, score, pass/fail, and latency.

Deploy an agent.

Types: `hosted` (API endpoint), `sdk_download` (downloadable SDK package)

`agent_version: null` uses the agent's current version.
Stops a deployment. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Frameworks
item.description: Discover registered framework adapters and their supported models.

request.description: Lists all registered framework adapters with version info and supported models.
Get details for a specific framework adapter by name.

item.name: Tools
item.description:
Tool registry with categorized catalog, schema definitions, encrypted auth config, and playground testing.

## Pre-Built Catalog (v0.2.0)
61 LangChain tools across 20 categories are seeded at startup. Browse categories, filter by category/framework, and test tools in the playground before using them in agents.

request.description:
List all tool categories with their tool counts.

Returns 20 categories: search, research, browser, communication, devtools, files, database, data_analysis, speech_audio, image_vision, documents, moderation, weather_location, finance, travel, media, science, automation, blockchain, utility.

Each category includes a `display_name` (human-readable) and `tool_count`.

List all active tools, optionally filtered by category and/or framework.

Pre-built tools have `tool_type: "builtin"` and include `required_keys` (API keys needed for playground) and `input_schema` (expected input format).
Register a new custom tool. The `schema` field defines the tool's interface. `auth_config` values are encrypted at rest. `category` is optional for custom tools.
Get a tool by ID. Response includes `required_keys`, `input_schema`, and `test_status` for built-in tools.

Tool Playground — execute a built-in tool with your own API keys and input.

**How it works:**
1. Provide the API keys the tool requires (check `required_keys` from Get Tool)
2. Provide input query/parameters (check `input_schema` from Get Tool)
3. The tool executes and returns actual output
4. Evaluate the output and decide whether to use the tool in your agent

**Response:**
- Always returns HTTP 200
- `status: "success"` — tool worked, `output` contains the result
- `status: "failed"` — tool errored, `error` contains the error message
- `latency_ms` — execution time in milliseconds

**Note:** Only works for built-in tools with a `langchain_class`. Custom tools return 422.

item.name: MCP Servers
item.description: Register, test, and manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Filesystem Tools",
  "description": "MCP server providing filesystem access tools",
  "transport": "stdio",
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/tmp/workspace"],
  "env_vars": {},
  "auth_header": null
}

request.description: Register a stdio-based MCP server. Uses `command` + `args` to launch the server process.
Register an SSE/HTTP-based MCP server. Uses `url` to connect. `env_vars` and `auth_header` are encrypted at rest.
List all MCP servers registered by the authenticated user. Secrets are masked in responses.
Tests connectivity to the MCP server. Returns reachability status, discovered tools, latency, and any errors. Updates the server's status in the database.
Delete an MCP server registration. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Connected Services
item.description:
OAuth connections to external providers (Google, Slack, GitHub). Manage user consent, store encrypted tokens, and issue fresh access tokens for agent runtime.

Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET env vars for Google support.

request.description: Exchange a Google authorization code for tokens. Stores encrypted refresh token and granted scopes. Creates a new connection or updates an existing one.
List all connected services for the authenticated user. Returns provider, email, status, and granted scopes.
Get Google connection status and granted scopes. Returns connected=true/false, scope list, and associated email.
Get a fresh Google access token by refreshing the stored refresh token. Used by agent tools at runtime. Returns 410 if the token was revoked by the user at Google.
Disconnect Google — permanently deletes stored refresh token and granted scopes. Returns 204 No Content.
